notes.title: New features and bug fixes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Here are the details of this update:



Village Capture

When you destroy Alek's or Victor Muller's village, a progress bar is activated to show the progress of the village capture. The more soldiers you have in the village, the faster the capture. Once the village is captured, you can build buildings there.



Features and Improvements

We can now attack enemies with our weapon while sitting on our mount.

When you cut wood or mine resources on occupied land, an alert message will appear to tell you that you will lose reputation with the hero who owns the land.

Our mount feeds automatically when it has food in its inventory.

When you ask your cave troll or mammoth to patrol your village, they protect it from enemies and automatically feed at the general store.

When you ask them to patrol an enemy village, they destroy all the buildings in the village.

I worked on the AI ​​pathing system.

Pigs yield more bacon when killed by your farmer.

Some texts have been reworked.

I redid all the foundations of the village buildings.

I refined the characters' hair.

I reworked the game's lighting.

I fixed several bugs.

Multiplayer

I started working on implementing the multiplayer mode.

I structured the session system to allow hosting or joining an online game.

I still need to replicate some of the code. Once that's done, I'll release an experimental update so we can test the multiplayer mode.



Thank you for your support :) Blackmyers

notes.title: Bug fixes and optimizations
notes.notes:
Hello Adventurers,

A new update has just been released! It fixes several annoying bugs and improves overall performance across the Kingdom, especially loading times.

The Main Menu and the World of Zarabon now load in just a few seconds.

Bugs Fixed:
- Fixed the bug where the horse would detach from the cart
- Fixed the issue where villagers floated in the air upon spawning
- Enemies are no longer launched into the air when hit by the player

Optimizations:
- Improved code for better performance
- Reduced loading times for the Main Menu and the World of Zarabon

Next Step:
I’m currently working on controller support for the game.

In the meantime, feel free to report any bugs you encounter.
Thank you for your support, and enjoy the game!

Blackmyers
http://www.blackmyers.com

notes.title: Hero Creator Experimental Update 1.32 Final Part
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, here is the final part of the experimental version of the 1.32 update.

Detail to access the Hero Creator Experimental update
Visit our website for details on how to download this update: Website

The game is now available in several languages
The game is now translated into Spanish, Arabic, Chinese, Hindi, Japanese, Portuguese (Brazil), German and Russian.

Other languages ​​will be translated soon. Let us know which languages you would like to see.

We used Google Translate to do the translation. There may be some errors in the translation.

Here are the updates in this version:

Rabbit Traps
You can now create and set rabbit traps.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/96cfdc818f38547e80e04187975ee1487242ad0a.jpg

Rabbit Shelter
You can place captured rabbits in a shelter. After a while, they will evolve into Buckdjeuves. Once evolved, you can ride the Buckdjeuve.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/dd575500b976081552b034a5e0aaaf5e96e74ff2.jpg

Caribou Traps
You can now create and set caribou traps to capture and tame them. Once tamed, you can ride the caribou.

Sabertooth Traps
You can now create traps to capture and tame sabertooths. Once tamed, you can ride the sabertooth.

Dominating the Cave Troll and the Mammoth
When you engage in combat with the cave troll, a domination bar appears, showing the timer running out. If you manage to defeat the troll before the time expires, it will fall to its knees and you will have a chance to tame it. Once tamed, you can ride it and wreak havoc on enemies and their villages.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/86fdde6c742daf4be2d14405791cec69f2b25d57.png

Store Manager
When you hire a store manager, they will be responsible for clearing surplus goods from the general store and purchasing requested goods from the neighboring village.

Village Manager
We can now hire one of your heroes to manage and protect your villages. They will manage the workers' jobs and rebuild destroyed buildings. However, you will need to pay them for their services.

Yeti Village
There are now Yeti villages in the Snowy Mountains biome. They are neutral by nature, but you can develop relationships with them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/53a030d27a2cb6c1b3dde0895d8dddfaee17cd27.png

Yeti Horn
When used in one of your Snowy Mountain villages, the Yeti Horn sends a distress signal to the neighboring village, and the Yeti leader will send reinforcements to protect your village from enemies for a while.

Jacob Bright
A tall, strange man wearing a wolf pelt wanders the forests. You can complete tasks for him, which will increase your reputation with the werewolves. However, be careful: once he transforms into a werewolf, he becomes very dangerous if you are not allied with them.

Dynamic Quest Generator
I've created a dynamic quest generator system that generates quests based on the person's requests. The workers with an exclamation mark will have tasks for you. I've created many different quests to help the workers and their villages.

Heroes will request more difficult quests, but the rewards will be greater.

Large Lantern
You can now build large lanterns that will light up your village and caves.

All game code has been optimized
I had to optimize all the game code for better memory management. The game now runs very smoothly.

Please start a new game to avoid any compatibility issues.

Feel free to join the Official Game Discord to chat with the community, share your suggestions, and help us find bugs!

Don't forget to save your previous game before starting a new one!

In earlier versions, I introduced new biomes, creatures to tame, and various gameplay improvements that enhanced village management and exploration. Each update brought new challenges and exciting additions, and we’re thrilled to continue expanding the game with this new update!

Biomes are different types of zones or environments within the game, each with its own unique characteristics, resources, and creatures:
-Snowy Mountains: A cold biome with icy landscapes, home to creatures like Yeti and specific resources suited to this climate.
-Forests: Dense, wooded areas where you can find a variety of animals, natural resources, and lush vegetation.
-Plains: Open, grassy areas ideal for farming and exploration.

Each biome offers a unique experience with specific challenges to overcome.

Thanks for your support and enjoy the game :)

Blackmyers
www.blackmyers.com

Hi everyone, here is the list of additions that I implemented in the Hero Creator 1.32 Experimental update.

Detail to access the Hero Creator update
Visit our website for details on how to download this update: Website

NEW FEATURES
Training Camp
Soldiers will now train when they have nothing to do.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/af037d481c385ada3593376dec23d36773a2a938.jpg

Snow on Building
There is now snow on all buildings in the snowy mountain biome.

House Confort
Houses use wood for heating in winter.

Workbench Level 2
I added the workbench level 2 which will allow us to make more advanced things.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/fd24885da52b1f56ab2babd45d67405175a39b6e.png

Wood Cabin
You can build a small wooden cabin that will allow you to warm up and protect you from bad weather.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/f5fe1ac0c913ec79f6537e1d12828b90e3b5805b.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/8d54debe370da1313a210df193b3b9893ca54534.jpg

New Pickaxe
You can now obtain the Steel Pickaxe recipe by defeating the Spider Boss and the Silver Pickaxe recipe by defeating the Elemental in the caves.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/ab6691823ece5b677ab19cbb93434c666e10c981.png

Road System
You can build roads in your village that will allow you to have smoother traffic. You can choose the name of your roads.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/0543850e942b8fcfc3d41b9c3473715bf857c47e.jpg

Cave protection
You can ask your soldiers to clear the village caves from enemies.

Split item stack

Thanks for your support and good game :)

notes.title: Update 1.3 is now available
notes.notes:
Update 1.3 is now available.

New Game Modes

War Mode
In War mode you start directly to build your village on random land and you have to defend your village against Victor's attacks. The first who destroy the enemy village wins the game.

Survival Mode
In Survival mode, you start the game with nothing. You must start harvesting your resources to be able to craft your weapons and tools that will allow you to survive. Find work in neighboring villages to help you earn money and then buy your own land which will allow you to build your village.

New hero Victor Muller
Victor will build his village and you will be able to challenge him or help him progress

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/eb42506358a8177f37a74b59d46a13201dff66be.png

Reputations among heroes
The actions you take towards Victor will have a direct impact on your reputation. If you threaten or attack his village and the people who live there, your reputation will plummeted and you will become an enemy. Then Victor will attack you constantly to be able to invade your village.

And if you do tasks for Victor, your reputation will increase. And you can become an allied and trade together. 

Economic Exchange System
Sell your overstock goods to the allied village and you can also request missing food, resources and equipment for your village.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/9a620f726f99de624e429565d0bdaf449a761e76.png

Stone Wall
Build stone walls to strengthen your defenses

Horse Stable
Hire a stable man to breed and maintain your horses. You have the option of buying young horses (foals) at a low price or more expensive adult horses. Attach a wagon to your horse to deliver goods to the Allied Village or to collect your resources. This will allow you to carry more resources. You can also ride the horse to travel the world of Zarabon faster.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/e9fb52d9c988bf6d06b7e74ca5ba7a25c453c4b4.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/df0e1dac07c8c99568ef590f669f7d523316ee16.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/28df13e044781618507d61dffbd2a2bec5e51375.png

Water Well
Your stable men will collect water for your horses.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/26df0b68ca17e5bf77e761c8ee1a7cba5cb27e9b.png

Climb in the towers
You can climb in the towers for better defend your village.

Extension of land
You can now purchase land extensions for your village. This will allow your workers to seek resources elsewhere for your village.

Adding resources to the map
I added small rocks of stone and iron, small bush and mushroom that you can pick up by hand.

Alek Crafting Menu
I created a crafting menu for Alek to craft basic things from his inventory.

New weapons and armor
Redwood Bow, Wooden Crossbow, Crusher Hammer et Victorious Armor

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/3f6e29a142a3dda4cd92365432293c221d1b3648.png

Shroombiters
This poisonous little mushroom, which passes unnoticed in the forest, will attack you when you pass near it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/f690dc6584594ab54a9e3bc78ff0e4c213c58c04.png

Captain Skeletor's treasure
Explore the world of Zarabon and find the treasure chests but be careful, this chest belongs to the pirate captain. Confront him to get the key to open the treasure chest.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/51f1a3939e1ed2eb698628b074bab16b6274a1d3.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/64b7ad7ce44c62ae73195dd9aae27076bc64fe7a.png

Moon of blood
When the blood moon appears during the night, the goblins go crazy. They will regroup to attack your village together.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/8241c9dab7039e3c198bbd42c9bf7945c807e0c6.png

Task board
There will be random tasks that will be posted on the village board. You will be able to complete the tasks to make money and increase your reputation towards the village.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/9e25976ecdd32be651b47746a0eaaf301687271c.png

War Table
You can command your army to destroy enemy villages or protect allied villages.

New quests
Treasure hunt
Resource delivery
Victor's requests

Gamepad support

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/f903c788510af6aa8f95987421d2f2f824dcb1dd.png
